ref.substituent_description: Pyrrolidine N acylated as a urea C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2- to one N of a piperazine; the other piperazine N is on a para-disubstituted benzene whose para position carries O-CH2, joined by a hashed bond to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane. Dioxolane C2 bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and para) and, via a hashed bond, CH2 to N1 of an imidazole.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: urea C=O, 3+3 in the two benzene rings, 2 in imidazole (C2=N3, C4=C5). Two hashed bonds on the dioxolane carbons.

wrong.substituent_description: Same pyrrolidine-N-C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2-piperazine chain as the reference, but the piperazine N and the O-CH2 are on the central benzene in a 1,3 (meta) relationship (upper-left and upper-right vertices, separated by the top vertex). Dioxolane with two hashed bonds, 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and para) and CH2-imidazol-1-yl as in the reference.
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black. Benzene rings drawn with circles; imidazole drawn with explicit C=N and C=C. NH written as N with H below. Double bonds: C=O plus two in imidazole.

correct.substituent_description: Pyrrolidine N-C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2- to a piperazine N; the other piperazine N on a para-disubstituted benzene (circle) whose para position carries O-CH2 hashed to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane; dioxolane C2 bears 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and para) and a hashed bond to CH2-imidazol-1-yl.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Cl labels written in a loose cursive style, readable in context
hashed bonds drawn as hatch fans with small gaps to the adjoining bond lines
correct.notes: Handwritten, black. Double bonds: C=O and two in imidazole; benzene rings as circles.

errors_in_wrong.description: Reference central benzene is para (1,4)-disubstituted: piperazine N and the O-CH2 ether on opposite vertices. In the wrong drawing the piperazine N is on the upper-left vertex and the O on the upper-right vertex, i.e. meta (1,3) positions.

correct_version_issues.description: Both Cl labels on the dichlorophenyl ring are written in a loose cursive form that is readable in context but less clear than the reference Cl.

review_notes: Wrong drawing puts the piperazine and the O-CH2 meta on the central benzene instead of para. Everything else (rings, Cl positions, imidazole, both hashed bonds) matches. Corrected drawing restores para; only a minor cursive-Cl legibility note.
